0.long_answer: Imatinib mesylate is the tyrosine kinase inhibitor used for treating patients with hypereosinophilic syndrome featuring a PDGFRA-FIP1L1 fusion as well as those with chronic eosinophilic leukemia carrying a PDGFRA mutation. This drug works by targeting the constitutively active fusion kinase that arises from the FIP1L1-PDGFRA rearrangement, thereby inhibiting the unchecked cellular proliferation associated with these conditions.
